capabilities: Pull pending records from a WeChat mini program CloudBase inbox using a bind code
Convert supported webpage, article, and doc links into Markdown snapshots
Download audio and file attachments and write them into the vault
Transcribe audio via cloud speech providers or a local whisper.cpp helper
Extract Markdown from txt, md, docx, and text-based pdf attachments
disambiguation: Not device-to-vault syncing; it imports content collected in a WeChat mini program inbox into the vault.
extras: Desktop-only because it writes local binary attachments. In beta; can be tested with BRAT before Community Plugins approval. Default inbox folder and note names use Chinese labels (e.g. 临时收集).
motivation: The README states it is designed for a "send now, organize later" workflow: save items from WeChat first, pull them into Obsidian later.
problem: Content collected in WeChat (articles, voice clips, documents) has no direct path into Obsidian, so users must manually save and convert it.

relations.evidence: The WeChat mini program saves selected content to the user's CloudBase inbox.
It installs whisper.cpp, ffmpeg, and a small Whisper model

requires.name: WeChat mini program inbox with a CloudBase sync API and bind code
Speech-to-text provider key (Tencent Cloud ASR, Alibaba Cloud, or Doubao)

summary: Pulls text, webpage links, audio, and files saved in a WeChat mini program inbox into the vault as Markdown notes and local attachments.
